This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. we love a crockpot meal around here 🙋🏼‍♀️ can’t go wrong with Marry Me Chicken Orzo (full recipe below!)🫶🏼 Ingredients -1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts -¾ cup sun-dried tomatoes, mostly drained and chopped -4 cloves garlic, minced -1 small yellow onion, finely diced -2½–3 cups low-sodium chicken bone broth, divided -1 tsp Italian seasoning -½ tsp paprika -1 tsp salt, plus more to taste -1 tsp black pepper -red pepper flakes (to taste, optional) -1½ cups dry orzo -3/4 cup half & half (can use more or less depending on how creamy you like it!) -½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese -2 cups baby spinach -Fresh basil, for serving Instructions Add chicken breasts, sun-dried tomatoes (I also like to add in a little splash of the oil they’re in too for some extra flavor), garlic, onion, 1½ cups chicken bone broth, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes to the crockpot. Stir to combine. Cover and cook on low for 3–4 hours or high for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked. Remove the chicken from the crockpot and shred using a hand mixer or two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the crockpot and stir into the sauce. Stir in 1½ cups dry orzo and 1 additional cup chicken bone broth. Make sure the orzo is mostly submerged in liquid! This chicken pot pie over biscuits is the ultimate cozy fall comfort meal! Made with shredded rotisserie chicken, mixed vegetables, a creamy homemade filling, and plenty of cheddar cheese, all served over warm, fluffy biscuits. It’s an easy weeknight dinner that brings all the comfort of chicken pot pie without the extra work of making a pie crust. I grabbed my ingredients at @Food Lion to make this family favorite!  Chicken Pot Pie Over Biscuits  Ingredients:  4 tablespoons butter  1 medium yellow onion, chopped  1/4 cup all purpose flour  1 tablespoon minced garlic  2 cups Food Lion chicken broth  1 Food Lion chicken bouillon cube  1 cup milk  1 bag Food Lion frozen mixed vegetables  1 Food Lion rotisserie chicken, shredded  8 ounces Food Lion cheddar cheese, freshly grated  Food Lion biscuits  Seasonings, to taste:  Onion Powder Garlic Powder Celery Salt Dried Parsley Black Pepper  Directions:  Preheat the oven and bake the biscuits according to the package directions.  Shred the Food Lion rotisserie chicken and set aside.  Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.  Add the flour and minced garlic. Stir well and cook for about 2 minutes. Slowly pour in the chicken broth, stirring until smooth and well combined.  Add the chicken bouillon cube and season with onion powder, garlic powder, celery salt, dried parsley, and black pepper. Pour in the milk and stir until combined.  Add the frozen mixed vegetables, shredded rotisserie chicken, and freshly grated cheddar cheese. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is combined.  Cover the skillet and let the filling cook for 5 minutes.  Place the warm biscuits in bowls and spoon the creamy chicken pot pie filling over the top. Serve warm!  #FallingforFoodLion #sponsored #FoodLion #EasyDinner #OnePotMeal

Creamy, a little spicy, and packed with cajun flavor 🌶️ Ingredients (2 servings): Chicken breast ~ 300 g (10.5 oz) Pasta ~ 200 g (7 oz) Onion – 1/2 pc Garlic – 1–2 cloves Fresh tomato – 1/2 medium, diced Heavy cream – 200 ml (3/4 cup + 1 tbsp) Parmesan – 40 g (1.5 oz) Avocado oil / olive oil – 1 tbsp Butter – 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning (paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, oregano, thyme) – 2 tbsp, to taste Salt – to taste Pasta water – as needed Fresh parsley – for serving Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breast horizontally into two thinner steaks. Season both sides generously with cajun seasoning and salt. 2. Heat avocado oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for a few minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. In the same pan, melt the butter. Add the diced onion and cook until softened. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Then add the diced fresh tomato and cook for another 2 minutes. 4. Pour in the heavy cream, add a little more cajun seasoning, and stir until combined. Add the grated parmesan and let the sauce simmer gently until creamy. 5. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve some pasta water before draining. 6. Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and toss until well coated. Add a splash of pasta water if needed to get that silky consistency. 7. Slice the chicken into strips, place on top of the pasta, and finish with freshly grated parmesan and chopped fresh parsley. Crispy, cheesy Chicken Parmesan with homemade tomato sauce and a fresh Caesar salad. The perfect comfort dinner! Ingredients: For the chicken: • 2 chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • Salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika • ½ cup all-purpose flour • 2 eggs, beaten • 1 cup Italian breadcrumbs • ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese • Oil for frying • Shredded mozzarella cheese For the homemade tomato sauce: • 1 small onion, finely chopped • 1–2 tbsp olive oil • 1½ cups tomato sauce • Salt & pepper, to taste • ½ tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp dried basil • 1 tsp sugar Instructions: 1. Make the sauce: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the chopped onion until soft. Add tomato sauce, salt, pepper, dried parsley, basil and sugar. Stir and simmer for 10–15 minutes. 2. Prepare the chicken: Slice chicken breasts in half lengthwise and pound until evenly thin. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika. 3. Coat each piece in flour, dip into beaten eggs, then cover with breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan. 4. Fry in oil over medium heat until golden and crispy on both sides. 5. Transfer chicken to a baking dish, spoon homemade tomato sauce over each piece and top generously with mozzarella. 6. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 10–15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the chicken is fully cooked (165°F internally). Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil, add all seasonings, and toss to coat evenly. 3. Add sliced onion, chicken broth, and fresh thyme. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 5. Remove from oven and increase temperature to 450°F. 6. Remove thyme and carefully pour the cooking liquid into a bowl or measuring cup. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then whisk it into the cooking liquid to make your gravy. 7. Pour the gravy back over the chicken. 8. Return to the oven, uncovered, for another 30 minutes at 450°F, until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is beautifully browned! Serve over mashed potatoes with your favorite sides and ENJOY!
